svg.title: LC2K execution trace · V2.1
svg.desc: Abstract stage snapshots of two loads, an add and a halt. Original trace values preserved; queue entries shown in physical slot order with empty slots omitted. Not a circuit schematic.

g.text: Each load becomes address calculation + memory access.
The load holds the issue packet. Address results write back.
The first load receives word 0 from block 4.
The next load receives word 1; r1 writes back as 5.
WB lane 1 supplies r2 = 6. The ADD computes 5 + 6 = 11.
HALT reaches execution while the ADD writes back 11.
r1 = 5, r2 = 6, r3 = 11. Younger operations are flushed.
WB lane 1 supplies r2 = 6. The ADD computes 5 + 6 = 11.
